text.2:77: Are they then unaware that Allah knoweth that which they keep hidden and that which they proclaim?
text.11:5: Lo! now they fold up their breasts that they may hide (their thoughts) from Him. At the very moment when they cover themselves with their clothing, Allah knoweth that which they keep hidden and that which they proclaim. Lo! He is Aware of what is in the breasts (of men).
text.14:38: Our Lord! Lo! Thou knowest that which we hide and that which we proclaim. Nothing in the earth or in the heaven is hidden from Allah.
text.16:19: And Allah knoweth that which ye keep hidden and that which ye proclaim.
text.16:23: Assuredly Allah knoweth that which they keep hidden and that which they proclaim. Lo! He loveth not the proud.
text.27:25: So that they worship not Allah, Who bringeth forth the hidden in the heavens and the earth, and knoweth what ye hide and what ye proclaim,
text.27:74: Lo! thy Lord knoweth surely all that their bosoms hide, and all that they proclaim.
text.28:69: And thy Lord knoweth what their breasts conceal, and what they publish.
text.36:76: So let not their speech grieve thee (O Muhammad). Lo! We know what they conceal and what proclaim.
text.60:1: O ye who believe! Choose not My enemy and your enemy for allies. Do ye give them friendship when they disbelieve in that truth which hath come unto you, driving out the messenger and you because ye believe in Allah, your Lord? If ye have come forth to strive in My way and seeking My good pleasure, (show them not friendship). Do ye show friendship unto them in secret, when I am Best Aware of what ye hide and what ye proclaim? And whosoever doeth it among you, he verily hath strayed from the right way.
text.64:4: He knoweth all that is in the heavens and the earth, and He knoweth what ye conceal and what ye publish. And Allah is Aware of what is in the breasts (of men).
text.71:9: And lo! I have made public proclamation unto them, and I have appealed to them in private.
